name: Raub
description: Raub is a Croatan trick-taking game. 2-4 players. 32 cards (7-A). Declarer must make at least 2 of 4 tricks; each defender must make 1 or drop. Dealer can say 'Raub' (take face-up trump, make 2) or 'Trick' (7 up, make 1). Bidding: 'I lead'. Refusal (Refa) doubles next. Start 21; lose points for failures.

history.origins: Raub is played by Croatians in the United States, though the actual origin of the game is uncertain. This description was contributed by Davorin Fundak, who learned the game in Oregon, from a relative in Ohio.

setup.players: Two to four active players; best with four. Play is clockwise.

rules.objective: Declarer: make 2+ tricks. Defenders: make 1 each or drop. Start 21; lose for failure. Refa (all pass) doubles next hand.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal 4 each; turn trump. 2. Dealer: Raub (take trump, make 2) or Trick (7 up, make 1) before seeing hand. 3. Else bidding: 'I lead' = declarer; can exchange up to 4. 4. Defenders: Idem (play) or Nejdem (drop). Must make 1 if playing. 5. Play 4 tricks. 6. Scoring.
keyRules: Declarer: 2+ tricks. Defenders: 1 each or drop.
Raub = take trump, make 2. Trick = 7 up, make 1.
Refa = all pass; double next hand.

strategy.basic: Bid with strong trump. Drop if weak.
tips: Forpass: play if others drop. Surpass supersedes.

scoring.description: Start 21. Lose for failures. Refa doubles.
